visualCharacteristics.purpose: checkbox filter chips (or a year selector) that filter the listing below them

contentPattern.structure: optional heading (filter label), then filter values as a list, paragraphs or one per row. A value starting with All clears the filter. 8+ values, or all years, render as a select

reuseGuidance: Place directly before the listing block (cards-article, cards-product, table-product) in the same section, or at the end of the section before it. Items match when their text contains a selected value.
decisions: The source filters server-side; the block filters the next block's items client-side by text.
